newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel strengthens in muted trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel strengthens in muted trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel strengthened on the back of IPE gas oil futures on Thursday in meagre volume, traders said.
Dec IPE traded up $4.50 at $220.75 a tonne, off its earlier high of $223, after profit taking on NYMEX heating oil took the edge of renewed IPE bullishness.

Traders reported demand for cargoes but said it was difficult to satisfy from small parcels without paying barge numbers. Cargoes were around Dec +$30/31. A barge was sold firmer at $249 outright, equivalent to Dec IPE +31. Traders reported no fob availabilities out of Britain.
Buying interest in the Med was poor. Premiums were high quotes fob Med +$5/7.
